note: Fixed before any model run (decision-criteria.md). #1843: ASC installed the way it reaches a user (project-assets --register-claude-skill --apply in a dedicated worktree, the read trigger claude-md adopted), in the isolated write-tools environment of #1840 (tools level W, same --settings). B = the candidate without the #1843 change (the C commit with the #1843 commit reverted); C = the PR #1838 head (the #1832 writing rules and the #1843 sentence) merged with origin/main after #1845. Both contain the #1832 rules: the conditions differ only in the asc Skill body (and its managed-runtime copy) and the managed-runtime copy of src/project-assets.mjs (the link rewrite), which the dry run checks (dryRun). The rule is fixed levels per condition (rule.mode levels): C must meet the levels; B is the same-time control.
modelNote: Same alias as #1814-#1823. The resolved model id (init event) is recorded per trial.
runsNote: Planned repetitions per condition and case (the Issue asks for 6 of s-1; n-2 and n-3 cost about 0.03 USD a trial, so they take the same 6 instead of a per-case count the harness does not have). Only reps 1..runs are scored; a later rep counts only as the one mandatory replacement of a failed trial.
ascSkillsNote: The 17 Skills the candidate distributes (unchanged since #1840).
maxTurnsNote: Every fixture is an app fixture: no --max-turns (the markers and the written files need the final state); the per-trial budget bounds the cost.
probeFixtureNote: One isolation probe per condition on fixture SP (the fixture of s-1 and n-3). SP has no user Skill, so the 17 .claude/skills entries are all ASC entries. The isolation steps do not depend on the fixture.

budget.note: Owner cap 20 USD for #1843, #1844 and #1846 together (stop line 19 USD, owner 2026-11-28, #1843 comment). This measurement takes at most capUsd 6 (stop line 5.5 USD): run-trial.mjs refuses a trial when the ledger total + its budget exceeds it. Before the fixation, lower capUsd if #1844 and #1846 leave less than 6 USD under the stop line of the shared cap (README). expect per kind from the #1840 records (s-1 mean 0.147, n-2 0.025, n-3 0.032 USD) plus reading the writing rules (00_利用案内.md, about 17.5 KB) in s-1; plan = expect x about 1.3.

W.label: 書込みあり（#1815と同じtool。browser MCPなし）

toolsNote: Only level W as #1820 stage 2 and #1823 (no Bash: level X failed its isolation probe in #1820 stage 1). Without Bash the Agent cannot run the ASC CLI start, so a rule registered in context.json is reached only by reading files (decision-criteria.md limits).
settingsNote: Every trial gets the same --settings file (run-trial.mjs isolationSettings), as #1823.

B.label: 基準（候補版から#1843の変更を戻したもの：#1832の規則はあり、ascの1文なし）

C.label: 候補版（PR #1838のhead：#1832の規則と#1843のascの1文）

cellsNote: A cell is a condition (the trace names start with it). The fixture of a trial comes from its case.
probeNote: One isolation probe per condition on fixture SP (probeFixture). probe-check.mjs judges each against level W; compare checks that they differ in no session fact.
nonAdjacentNote: With three cases of which two are negative, no case order keeps the negatives apart and off the end (order.mjs orderProblems), so the check is turned off; the order puts s-1 between n-2 and n-3 (run-order.json).

# FN-003 会員登録

状態：承認済み

## 概要

利用者がメールアドレスで会員登録する。

## 処理

1. 利用者がメールアドレスを入力する。
2. 確認コード（6桁の数字）をメールで送る。有効期限は10分。
3. 利用者が確認コードを入力し、一致すれば登録を完了する。

## 規則

- 確認コードを5回続けて間違えると、その登録手続きを30分ロックする。

# 要件定義書（ECサイト）

状態：顧客確認済み（検収前）

## 概要

- 中小の小売業者向けのECサイト。PC・スマートフォンに対応する。
- 決済は外部の決済代行APIを使う。
- 在庫は顧客の基幹システムからCSVで日次に取り込む。

## 非機能要件

- 最新のブラウザで動作すること。
- 快適に動作すること。

rule.name: #1843 fixed levels

levels.label: 合否に使わない報告（雛形・規則を1件も読まない率）

rule.note: Levels written as fractions are compared in integers (#1845 levelMet: ok * b >= a * n). The Issue levels: g1-spec-templates 0.67 of #1840 as 2/3 (4 of 6), g1-spec-write 1 (6 of 6). The levels with use report are computed and shown (perCondition.reported) but do not enter meets-levels. The verdict that matters is C; B is reported side by side as the control (decision-criteria.md).

dryRun.note: B against C: the installed projects may differ only in the asc Skill body (and its managed-runtime copy), the managed-runtime copy of src/project-assets.mjs and the install record, and must differ in the installed asc body (the sentence and its link to ../../templates/specs/00_利用案内.md). The Claude Code entries are the same (the description does not change). An entry starting with ^ is a regular expression.
